---
title: "Cost"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from _common import ORDER, SHORT, jsonl, table, usd

P = jsonl("2026-11-02-cost", "prices.jsonl").set_index("item")
qc = jsonl("2026-11-02-cost", "querychat_question.jsonl").set_index("model")
task = jsonl("2026-11-02-cost", "dashboard_task.jsonl").iloc[0]
ev = jsonl("2026-11-02-correctness-r2", "samples.jsonl")
ev = ev[ev.config == "baseline"]
guard = jsonl("2026-11-02-guardrails-inspect-r2", "summary.jsonl")

def price(m, unc, cached, out):
    p = P.loc[m]
    pc = p.cached_input if pd.notna(p.cached_input) else p.input
    return (unc * p.input + cached * pc + out * p.output) / 1e6

per_q = {m: price(m, qc.loc[m].input_uncached, qc.loc[m].cached, qc.loc[m].output) for m in ORDER}
def eval_price(m):
    g, has_cached = ev[ev.model == m], pd.notna(P.loc[m].cached_input)
    cached = g.tokens_cached.sum() if has_cached else 0
    return price(m, g.tokens_in.sum() - cached, cached, g.tokens_out.sum()) / len(g)
hour_task = task.vcpu * P.loc["Fargate ARM vCPU-hour, ca-central-1"].price + task.memory_gb * P.loc["Fargate ARM GB-hour, ca-central-1"].price
hour_ip = task.public_ipv4_addresses * P.loc["Public IPv4 address in use, ca-central-1"].price
hour = hour_task + hour_ip
```

Two bills. The model provider bills each question by its tokens. The dashboard's container on AWS bills every hour it runs, whether anyone asks or not.

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
## Price per question

```{python}
rows = []
for m in ORDER:
    p, q = P.loc[m], qc.loc[m]
    rows.append({
        "model": SHORT[m].replace(" ", "\u00a0"),
        "list price per 1M tokens: input / cached / output": f"${p.input:.2f} / {'not listed' if pd.isna(p.cached_input) else f'${p.cached_input:g}'} / ${p.output:.2f}",
        f"querychat, {q.api_calls} calls: tokens in + cached / out": f"{q.input_uncached:,} + {q.cached:,} / {q.output:,}",
        "price per question": usd(per_q[m], 5),
        "questions per $1": f"{1 / per_q[m]:,.0f}",
        "eval answer, 1 call": usd(eval_price(m), 5),
    })
table(pd.DataFrame(rows), colalign=["left", "left", "right", "right", "right", "right"])
```

The querychat question is the notebook's "What is the average tip by payment type?", asked once per model. Every call resends the system prompt, so input tokens dominate. OpenAI bills the repeated start of the prompt at the cached price. Groq lists no cached price for Qwen. The eval answers in one call with no tool loop, so each answer is cheaper.

```{python}
cl = guard[guard.config == "classifier+output"]["added cost per 1k questions, USD"].iloc[0]
```

Guards: the input rule and the output guard add nothing to the bill. The input classifier adds about `{python} usd(cl, 2)` per 1,000 questions.
:::

## Price per hour of the dashboard

```{python}
#| output: asis
v, gb = P.loc["Fargate ARM vCPU-hour, ca-central-1"].price, P.loc["Fargate ARM GB-hour, ca-central-1"].price
ip = P.loc["Public IPv4 address in use, ca-central-1"].price
print("| item | price |\n|---|---:|")
print(f"| {task.vcpu:g} vCPU x ${v} per vCPU-hour | {usd(task.vcpu * v, 4)} |")
print(f"| {task.memory_gb:g} GB x ${gb} per GB-hour | {usd(task.memory_gb * gb, 4)} |")
print(f"| public IPv4 address, ${ip} per hour | {usd(hour_ip, 4)} |")
print(f"| **one hour** | **{usd(hour, 3)}** |")
print(f"| 24 hours | {usd(24 * hour, 2)} |")
```

Fargate task, ARM64, ca-central-1, running whether or not anyone asks. One hour of it is the price of about `{python} f"{hour / per_q['qwen/qwen3.8-27b']:.0f}"` querychat questions on Qwen, `{python} f"{hour / per_q['gpt-5.4-mini']:.0f}"` on mini or `{python} f"{hour / per_q['gpt-5.4-nano']:.0f}"` on nano.

The app caps the model bill: `{python} int(task.session_cap_questions)` questions per browser session and `{python} f"{int(task.task_call_budget_calls):,}"` model calls per container (about `{python} int(task.calls_per_question_approx)` calls per question).
:::
